description: Intent i012 (nested-parse-null-arg, snapshot s03) complete. Two high-confidence findings, both in drivers/net/ieee802154/mac802154_hwsim.c, where the seed's fix was NOT applied to sibling handlers: (1) hwsim_set_edge_lqi, lines 531-544: the required-attribute guard at 531-533 joins negated presence tests with && (logical inversion), so a MAC802154_HWSIM_CMD_SET_EDGE genl message (GENL_UNS_ADMIN_PERM, reachable from unprivileged user namespaces) that supplies RADIO_ID but omits RADIO_EDGE passes validation; hwsim_genl_policy (line 581) declares RADIO_EDGE as a plain optional NLA_NESTED, so info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_EDGE] stays NULL and is passed as the nesting attribute to nla_parse_nested_deprecated at line 535 (NULL deref via nla_len/nla_data); inner ENDPOINT_ID/LQI slots are additionally dereferenced at 543-544 under a second inverted && guard at 538-540. (2) hwsim_new_edge_nl, lines 421-432: identical inverted && guard at 421-423 feeding the optional NULL RADIO_EDGE slot into nla_parse_nested_deprecated at line 425, plus unguarded nla_get_u32(info->attrs[RADIO_ID]) at 431. The seed instance hwsim_del_edge_nl (483-487) already uses || in this snapshot and was excluded. Evidence: grep of all 145 files using nested-parse/iterate helpers in snapshots/s03, with the 21 direct attrs[]/tb[]-indexed parse/validate sites and 42 for_each sites triaged; every other site (nl802154.c 1565/1617/1794/1928/1962, macsec.c, ip_vs_ctl.c, netlabel_cipso_v4.c, act_api.c, cls_flower.c, udp_media.c, nl80211.c, wireguard, nbd, team, wil6210, nfc) proved to NULL-check the nesting attribute on the same or an adjacent guarded path. Limitations: sites whose nesting attribute flows through intermediate locals were not exhaustively traced; no build/reproducer run (tree has no top-level Makefile and is read-only); impact characterized as local DoS NULL-deref oops, not proven escalation.
